entities.name: Silas Duskmoor
entities.description: A legendary hunter whose divine blue flame served as the ultimate weapon to purify demonic corruption from dragons.
entities.quote: Silas Duskmoor’s divine blue flame = the dragons’ bane. It purified their demonic corruption.

entities.name: Azwain
entities.description: A disciplined prince struggling with his father's legacy and the wolf-kingdom's pack instincts.
entities.quote: Prince, polished, royalty-trained, heir to the wolf-kingdom. Grumpy, disciplined, but emotionally tied to his father’s legacy.

entities.name: Azwar
entities.description: A raw, tribal wolf fated to be the rival and potential killer of the wolf king and his pack.
entities.quote: Tribal wolf, raw, ordinary in appearance, no royal etiquette. The twist: destiny marks him as the killer of Azwain’s father and his pack.

entities.name: Duskmoor clan
entities.description: A group of specialized hunters dedicated to the destruction of colossal beasts and the culling of dragons.
entities.quote: Enter Duskmoor clan → dragon hunters, slayers of colossal beasts.

timeline_events.title: Jessy’s Betrayal Era
timeline_events.description: Dragons manipulated Jessy’s rage to incite genocide, hoping to dismantle the established balance of the beast realm.
timeline_events.quote: When humans and allied races turned against Jessy → dragons saw their chance. While Jessy’s rage boiled, dragons fueled her fire, whispering and nudging, turning her grief into genocide potential.

timeline_events.title: The Separation
timeline_events.description: Dragons attempted to infiltrate the human realm by taking human form, but lower dragons were exposed and culled by hunters.
timeline_events.quote: When the Separation happened, dragons saw opportunity: Humans trapped in their own realm. Other races blocked out. Perfect time to sneak in and dominate the weakest species.
